verdict.rationale: DPMA runs web services (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb) and distributes desktop software (DPMAdirektPro), so whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie consent or tracking opt-out. The robots.txt probe covers crawler access, not user tracking, so it is not relevant here.
